goal: Build accessible interfaces and deliberate, bounded page-to-research workflows.
acceptance: Capture/export is initiated by the user and restricted to the selected tab.
Permission, selection limits and excluded fields are visible; private source material stays local.
Keyboard, focus, reduced motion and narrow layouts are checked without claiming full WCAG certification.
prompt: Build an explicit Capture → Review → Export flow for selected text. Keep data on the device, record a sanitized source URL and timestamp, and reject restricted pages. Explain what was not captured.
